verdicts.reason: All rules hold: substring-quote plus section locator is program-readable, one clause type per pass and empty-as-result match the brief, status assisted does not exceed 'Assisted to reliable', and checkRunnable false is honest.

A3 fails: the brief requires scoring from one party's view, but the done-when only says each row carries a party and never checks that every row carries the same single named party, so a mixed-party sheet would pass.

All rules hold: the printed count with N = M+C+K = house clause count is program-readable, makes every missing clause and changed obligation a row so silence cannot read as fine, status assisted matches the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest.

All rules hold: a state diff confined to the flagged section, with the original verbatim and the flag id, enforces flagged-only, original-visible, no deal rewrite and edit tracked to flag; status assisted and the signing gate match 'Assisted, gated'; checkRunnable false is honest.

A1 fails: the done-when makes 'a person reviews subtle misquotes' a pass condition while checkKind is 'quote', so part of the pass is a human judgment rather than something a program reads, and checkKind does not declare that human part.

A3 fails: the brief says to list the documents in scope, but the done-when only prints a count N of in-scope documents and lists by name only the not-read ones, so the in-scope list is never enforced.
